fusions.name: Hundred-Pound Draw
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 10 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full range. It ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Staggering Flight
fusions.desc: Draws for 1 second, then looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart. Each deals 5 damage and stuns its target for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Taut String
fusions.desc: After a 1-second draw, your attacks and spells reach 40% further for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Bodkin Weight
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour.
